title: Spiced Lamb Tagine with Moroccan Flair
description: A unique fusion of Thai and Moroccan flavors in a hearty lamb tagine. Richly spiced and aromatic, this dish is perfect for adventurous foodies.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or clay pot over medium heat.
Brown the lamb shoulder on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic to the pot, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add Moroccan rub and curry paste, cooking for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and diced tomatoes, scraping up any browned bits.
Return lamb to the pot, cover, and bring to a simmer.
Transfer pot to the oven and cook at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Skim excess fat from the surface and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
